name: cx-siren
task: Go to the exit, and whenever the siren rings, turn it off.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: Existence(at_exit) captures the commanded goal 'Go to the exit', and Response(siren_ringing, switch_toggled) correctly encodes 'whenever the siren rings, turn it off' — 'whenever' maps to Response, siren_ringing is the condition, and switch_toggled is the action that stops the siren. The response closes properly because on the toggle step siren_ringing is already false, so the one-step event switch_toggled is not trapped while the condition still holds. Both clauses are hard, matching the task's categorical wording with no preference cue.

texts: Whenever the siren rings, toggle the switch to turn it off
